individual_branch.role: measure realized phenotype, ecology and lineage-specific response in concrete systems
individual_branch.ceiling: These systems do not by themselves validate PAYOFF architecture switching or identify syndrome causation.

spatial_branch.role: test whether within-species trait-transition structure learned in training species predicts strong within-species turnover in entirely unseen species
spatial_branch.ceiling: TTF transferability is not the same estimand as PAYOFF spatial spectral invasion and is not a formal PAYOFF projection without an explicit adapter.

reconvergence.meaning: compare how architecture-level alternatives are realized within focal systems and how turnover structure generalizes across species or space, then ask when suites of floral/reproductive traits cohere or decouple
reconvergence.ceiling: The three syndrome labels are research endpoints, not conclusions currently licensed by this site.

display_contract.visual_form: PAYOFF bifurcates into an individual-system exterior route and a spatial-transfer route, then reconverges near the ground into a three-gate syndrome court
